appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Selected High-Growth Quarters: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Five blue circular markers are plotted in a rising diagonal pattern from lower-left to upper-right.
Each marker is labeled Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6 in ascending order of position.
Q2 is the lowest-left point; Q6 is the highest-right point; Q3, Q4, Q5 lie between them in sequence.
X-axis runs from 25 to 75 with ticks at 5-unit intervals; Y-axis runs from 60 to 170 with ticks at 10-unit intervals.

printed_facts.fact: Point labels Q2, Q3, Q4, Q5, Q6 appear above their respective markers.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the quarterly marketing dashboard, then submit the budget approval decision.'
Primary field: 'Budget Approval Decision' with options: 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader ad-budget increase', 'Defer decision pending next budget cycle'.
Companion selects: 'Recommendation area' (Quarterly marketing budget), 'Review record' (High-growth quarter request), 'Decision queue' (Marketing approval review).
uncertain: Exact numeric coordinates of each quarter marker are not printed; positions are read visually from gridlines.
No policy table or explicit decision rule is provided to map the observed trend to a specific option.
The dashboard shows only five selected quarters (Q2–Q6); no baseline or full-data series is shown to confirm a 'broader' increase.
